note_en: Observations from building the dataset. These are descriptive measurements, not quality judgments; every item links to the raw data that produced it. Single prompt family, small N — read as signals, not conclusions.
note_zh: 构建数据集过程中的观察。全部是描述性测量,不是质量评判;每条都指向产生它的原始数据。单一提示族、小 N——当信号看,别当结论。

findings.title_zh: Claude 2025 年的写法,比 Claude 自己活得久
findings.body_en: Claude Sonnet 4 / 4.5, Opus 4.5 and Haiku 4.5 form one tight code-habit cluster with MiniMax M2.1–M2.7, Doubao Seed 2.1 Pro, Grok 4.3, DeepSeek V3.2, Qwen3-Coder-Next and Gemini 3 Flash / 3.1 Pro: cross-lab pairs score in the 96th–100th percentile on both prompts, as close as two configs of one model, across harnesses, efforts and all ten code channels. Claude itself moved on — Claude 4.5 against Claude Opus 4.8 / Claude 5 sits at the 23rd–44th percentile, no closer than two unrelated labs. One telltale line, “const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];”, is in 63% of Claude Sonnet 4/4.5 cards, 34% of the other members' cards, and none of 571 Claude Opus 4.8+ cards. GPT models of the same period never joined the cluster.
findings.body_zh: Claude Sonnet 4 / 4.5、Opus 4.5、Haiku 4.5 和 MiniMax M2.1–M2.7、豆包 Seed 2.1 Pro、Grok 4.3、DeepSeek V3.2、Qwen3-Coder-Next、Gemini 3 Flash / 3.1 Pro 组成一个紧密的代码习惯簇:跨厂商的配对在两个 prompt 上都落在第 96–100 百分位,和同一模型的两个 config 一样近,跨 harness、跨 effort、十个代码通道全部一致。Claude 自己却走开了——Claude 4.5 对 Claude Opus 4.8 / Claude 5 只有第 23–44 百分位,和两个不相干的厂商一样远。一行标志性代码 「const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];」 出现在 63% 的 Claude Sonnet 4/4.5 卡、34% 的其他成员卡里,而 571 张 Claude Opus 4.8+ 卡一张都没有。同时期的 GPT 从未进入这个簇。
findings.caveat_en: Code-habit fingerprint (v15), percentile among cross pairs of this 585-config set. Describes how the code is written, not where a model came from.
findings.caveat_zh: 代码习惯指纹(v15),在本 585 个 config 的跨配对中的百分位。描述的是代码怎么写,不是模型从哪来。

findings.title_en: At high effort, Claude and GPT start writing alike — and DeepSeek V4.1 already writes that way
findings.title_zh: 高 effort 下 Claude 和 GPT 开始写得一样——而 DeepSeek V4.1 本来就这么写
findings.body_en: Claude Opus 5 / 5.5 and GPT Sol are far apart at none–medium effort (40th–41st percentile) but meet at xhigh and above (78th–90th), across five harnesses; ordinary cross-family pairs gain almost nothing from high effort (37th→43rd). The shared code is defensive engineering — reduced-motion handling, aborting stale requests, “finally” clean-up — which low-effort Sol cards almost never contain (0–2%). DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scores at the 86th–91st percentile against that high-effort Claude/GPT set — the closest of 49 models from other labs — on both the official API and DeepSeek's own dsh harness, and reaches it at almost any effort setting.
findings.body_zh: Claude Opus 5 / 5.5 和 GPT Sol 在 none–medium 档相距很远(第 40–41 百分位),到 xhigh 及以上却汇合(第 78–90 百分位),五个 harness 上都成立;普通跨家族配对从高 effort 里几乎得不到什么(第 37→43 百分位)。共同的代码是防御型工程写法——处理减少动画偏好、中止过期请求、「finally」 收尾——低档 Sol 的卡几乎从不出现(0–2%)。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 对这组高档 Claude/GPT 落在第 86–91 百分位,是其他 49 个外家模型里最近的;官方 API 和 DeepSeek 自家 dsh harness 上都成立,而且几乎任何 effort 档都到得了。
findings.caveat_en: Code-habit fingerprint (v15). DeepSeek's dsh harness carries the defensive idioms more often than its API arm (88% vs 25% for reduced-motion); the fingerprint result holds on both.
findings.caveat_zh: 代码习惯指纹(v15)。DeepSeek 的 dsh harness 比 API 更常出现这些防御写法(reduced-motion 88% 对 25%);指纹结论在两边都成立。

findings.title_en: Some labs change hands between generations; GPT never does
findings.title_zh: 有的厂商换代就换了一手写法,GPT 从来没换
findings.body_en: GPT-6 cards still score at the 81st–86th percentile against GPT-5.x (3,300 config pairs). DeepSeek V4.1 against every earlier DeepSeek scores at the 49th–56th — an unrelated pair — while its two V4.1 builds (0910, 1017) agree at the 82nd–89th. Kimi K3 against Kimi K2.x: 55th–56th; K3 sits closer to Claude Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 (82nd–84th).
findings.body_zh: GPT-6 的卡对 GPT-5.x 仍在第 81–86 百分位(3,300 个 config 对)。DeepSeek V4.1 对所有更早的 DeepSeek 只有第 49–56 百分位——相当于不相干的一对——而它自己的两个构建(0910、1017)之间是第 82–89。Kimi K3 对 Kimi K2.x:第 55–56;K3 反而更靠近 Claude Fable 5 / Opus 4.8(第 82–84)。
findings.caveat_en: Code-habit fingerprint (v15); same-family-different-model pairs median 75th percentile for reference.
findings.caveat_zh: 代码习惯指纹(v15);同家族不同模型配对的中位数是第 75 百分位,可作参照。

findings.title_en: The harness changes how much a model draws — not how it writes
findings.title_zh: harness 改变模型画多少,不改变它怎么写
findings.body_en: Through a different harness the same model at the same effort keeps its code habits: on the v15 fingerprint, cross-harness pairs sit at the 98th–99th percentile, the same as the model's own re-runs, and two different-family models gain only 1–2 percentile points from sharing a harness. What the harness does move is the look (looks view: 88th against 92nd–94th for re-runs) and, above all, the volume of what gets drawn.
findings.body_zh: 同一模型、同一 effort 换一个 harness,代码习惯不变:在 v15 指纹上,跨 harness 配对落在第 98–99 百分位,和模型自己重跑一样;两个不同家族的模型共用一个 harness 也只多 1–2 个百分点。harness 真正改变的是外观(外观视角:第 88 百分位,重跑是第 92–94)和——最主要的——画出来的体量。
findings.caveat_en: Replaces an earlier version of this card (cross-arm 0.60–0.69 on the old raw channel average, measured on the gpt family only), which mistook the old scale's spread for a harness effect.
findings.caveat_zh: 取代本卡的旧版(旧的原始通道平均下跨臂 0.60–0.69,只在 gpt 家族测得),那一版把旧尺度的离散误读成了 harness 效应。

findings.title_en: Effort multiplies output size — up to 14x on fable-5
findings.title_zh: effort 放大输出体量——fable-5 最高 14 倍
findings.body_en: Through the Claude Code harness, raising effort from low to max grows the generated card by roughly 14x (fable-5), 12x (opus-4.8) and 9x (sonnet-5) in output volume. The knob visibly changes how much gets drawn.
findings.body_zh: 经 Claude Code harness,effort 从 low 拉到 max,产出卡片体量约放大 14 倍(fable-5)、12 倍(opus-4.8)、9 倍(sonnet-5)。这个旋钮真实改变了画多少东西。
findings.caveat_en: Output volume, not quality; single prompt family.
findings.caveat_zh: 是输出体量不是质量;单一提示族。

findings.title_en: On some models the effort knob does nothing measurable
findings.title_zh: 有些模型的 effort 旋钮拧了没反应
findings.body_en: haiku-4.5 (Claude Code harness) and grok-4.5 (official api) produce statistically indistinguishable output volume across every effort tier we ran. grok-4.3 on the same official api does respond to the knob.
findings.body_zh: haiku-4.5(Claude Code harness)和 grok-4.5(官方 api)在我们跑过的所有 effort 档位上输出体量无可辨差异。同一官方 api 上的 grok-4.3 对旋钮有响应。

findings.title_en: "minimal" effort does not exist on the official gpt api
findings.title_zh: 官方 gpt api 不存在 "minimal" 档
findings.body_en: The official /responses endpoint returns 400 for effort=minimal on every gpt model we probed. Where a "minimal" tier appears through proxy or harness channels, it is mapped by the channel, not the model provider.
findings.body_zh: 官方 /responses 对 effort=minimal 一律 400(我们探测过的每个 gpt 模型)。代理或 harness 通道里出现的 "minimal" 档是通道侧映射,不是官方档位。
findings.caveat_zh: 行为探测(接受/拒绝)所得,2026-07-18。

findings.body_en: Effort=max is accepted by gpt-5.6-sol / terra / luna and rejected (400) by every earlier gpt model on the official api.
findings.body_zh: 官方 api 上 effort=max 仅 gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna 接受,更早的 gpt 模型全部 400。

findings.title_en: Official api outputs run 5-8x larger than the same model via a proxy channel
findings.title_zh: 官方 api 输出比同模型代理通道大 5-8 倍
findings.body_en: For the same gpt model and effort, the official api produced 5-8x more card HTML than the reverse-proxy dev channel. Channel identity materially changes what you get — one reason this dataset separates channel grades.
findings.body_zh: 同一 gpt 模型同一 effort,官方 api 产出的卡片 HTML 是反代 dev 通道的 5-8 倍。通道本身实质性改变产出——这是本数据集区分通道等级的原因之一。
findings.caveat_en: Dev-channel data is not published; the comparison informed our channel-grade policy.
findings.caveat_zh: dev 通道数据不发布;该对比塑造了通道分级政策。

findings.title_en: Working inside an agentic harness is its own capability axis
findings.title_zh: 在 agentic harness 里干活是一条独立的能力轴
findings.body_en: Several previous-generation models that answer fine over the plain api fail outright (server 500) when driven through the opencode agentic harness on the same subscription channel. Tool-loop operation is not implied by api competence.
findings.body_zh: 多个上一代模型 api 直连正常作答,但在同一订阅通道的 opencode agentic harness 里直接 500。会答 api 不等于会在工具循环里干活。
findings.caveat_en: Gateway-side effect cannot be fully excluded.
findings.caveat_zh: 无法完全排除网关侧因素。

findings.title_en: kimi-k3 spends ~10x thinking on the qualitative prompt variant
findings.title_zh: kimi-k3 在质性提示变体上思考量 ~10 倍
findings.body_en: On the P-q (qualitative) prompt variant, kimi-k3's reasoning volume ran about 10x its P-min behavior — the largest variant sensitivity we observed.
findings.body_zh: 在 P-q(质性)提示变体上,kimi-k3 的思考量约为 P-min 的 10 倍——我们观察到的最大变体敏感度。
findings.caveat_en: Single model observation on a dev-grade channel; to be re-verified on a qualified channel.
findings.caveat_zh: 单模型、dev 级通道上的观察;待合格通道复核。
